# ElytraTarget

**Category:** Combat  
**Aliases:** ElytraTarget

## What it does

ElytraTarget turns your elytra into a homing missile against another player. While you're gliding, it automatically steers your view toward the selected target and keeps you pointed at them, even as they move and try to juke you. It's designed to work hand-in-hand with KillAura , so you can chase a target down in the air and land hits without manually fighting the elytra's momentum.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/combat/elytratarget). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
